properties.description: Reusable native-only internal helper for Cisco Intersight - Create workload definition. Keeps scalar preparation or polling below platform action and variable limits. No API calls, credentials or hardware targets. Import this helper before its caller; current-cloud native runtime verification remains required. Full internal purpose: Cisco Intersight - Native Create workload definition - Wait before definition validation poll. Integer seconds are required by Cisco Calculate Date and Sleep. Fractional delays round up by less than one second; an expired deadline stops the next API call.
